subject: Vendor intake form gaps, provisional PO assignment, and spend cap tweaks
messages:
From: Liam Chen <liam@meridian-analytics.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@meridian-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding packet + PO number request

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. We're ready to move forward with the onboarding but a couple of things are still blocking our internal purchase:

- The intake form you shared earlier is missing the GL code fields our finance team requires.
- We need a provisional PO number to reference in our procurement system so we can finish approvals this week.
- One of the line items ("User seats - professional") looks like it lists 120 seats in your catalog but our initial order is 12 — can you confirm pricing and a corrected line item row?

I've attached our completed onboarding form and the procurement contact for Meridian. Ideally we can get a PO stub and an updated line item CSV by tomorrow.

Attach: meridian_onboarding_form.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Liam Chen
Head of Procurement
Meridian Analytics
liam@meridian-analytics.com
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam@meridian-analytics.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onboarding packet + PO number request

Hi Liam — great to hear you're ready. Looping in Jordan (onboarding), Monica (procurement ops) and Kimberly (billing) to get the PO and GL fields sorted.

Jordan: can you pick this up and generate a provisional PO stub that includes the GL/code fields? Monica and Kimberly, Jordan and I flagged that the initial line item count in our catalog can be misleading — we'll need a corrected line item row with unit price for 12 seats and the SKU mapping.

Liam: I see your onboarding form — thanks. Monica will confirm the cap and issue the provisional PO number if everything checks.

Next steps (tentative):
- Jordan to produce a draft PO stub for Meridian (today)
- Monica to confirm spend cap and GL code mapping (today)
- Kimberly to confirm billing contact and finalize SOW references (tomorrow)

Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam@meridian-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onboarding packet + PO number request

Hi team — I've pulled the intake PDF and started a provisional PO. Two quick technical checks before I issue:

1) Meridian's onboarding form left GL Code blank for the "Professional - User Seat" line. Monica, do we map merchant-account 4401 or 4415 for seats?
2) The catalog SKU for "PRO-SEAT" currently lists a default quantity of 120 at the account level (legacy catalog). Liam, confirm you want 12 seats in the order line — I will create the line as quantity 12 and unit price $45 unless procurement provides a negotiated rate.

I'll attach the stub when ready; please flag any redlines.

Attach: provisional_PO_RWD-2026-9087.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Onboarding Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam Chen <liam@meridian-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onboarding packet + PO number request

Jordan — map seats to GL 4415 (SaaS subscriptions).

Liam — thanks for the form. I've reviewed and issued a provisional PO stub: RWD-2026-9087. Notes below:

- Provisional PO: RWD-2026-9087 (please reference this when you submit to Meridian finance)
- Spend cap assigned: $75,000 initial provisioning (can be increased via procurement ticket)
- Line item correction: "PRO-SEAT" replaced with line row: Qty 12 | Unit $45 | Ext $540 | GL 4415.
- Action required from Meridian: confirm billing email and provide PO approver name for audit.

I've attached the CSV stub and a short text file with the line-item revision notes. If Meridian confirms billing contact this morning, we can finalize in the ledger and release the provisional authorization.

Attach: provisional_PO_RWD-2026-9087.csv (csv); lineitem_revision_notes.txt (txt)

Monica Patel
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Liam Chen <liam@meridian-analytics.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Onboarding packet + PO number request

Quick finance check — thanks for the stub. Two items from my side:

- Can we reduce the initial spend cap to $50k while we await Meridian's legal signoff? Risk team prefers conservative provisioning for new vendors.
- Please include the cost-center tag: CC-NA-SALES-17 on the PO so we map to the right budget bucket.

Monica — if you confirm we can set the spend cap to $50k, I'll approve the ledger entry and confirm billing flow.

Marcus Lin
Financial Controller | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Liam Chen <liam@meridian-analytics.com>

Liam — thanks for the quick responses on the form. Summary / next steps: 

- Provisional PO issued: RWD-2026-9087 (attached stub).
- Line item corrected to 12 seats at $45/seat (Ext $540) and GL 4415.
- Spend cap set to $50,000 (per finance request). Monica will record cost-center CC-NA-SALES-17.
- Action for Meridian: please reply with the billing contact name and confirmation that the approver is "Priya Menon"; once we have that we'll mark the PO as active in the ledger.

I've included the updated stub and the revision notes in the thread. Monica/Kim, flag if anything else is needed from our side for the final ledger entry.

Best,
